events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Layhill
events.description: 1 death. Montgomery County. A tree fell onto a person along the Matthew Henson Trail resulting in a fatality.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Brandywine Woods
events.description: 1 death. Prince George's County. A tree fell onto a person in the 11700 block of North Marlton Avenue resulting in a fatality. A wind gust was estimated to be around 70 mph based on the report of 74 mph at Andrew Air Force Base about five miles to the southeast as well as analysis of the Terminal Doppler Weather Radar (TDWR) from Andrews Air Force Base (TADW) which showed about 70 mph 375 feet Above Ground Level (AGL).

events.title: Flash Flood near Mt Airy
events.description: 1 death. Carroll County. Thirteen year old boy swept into storm drainage in the 200 Block of Watersville Road in Mt Airy.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Mayfield
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Anne Arundel County. Numerous large trees and power lines blew down in Ridgeway. In the 1400 block of Maryland Avenue, a large tree blew down onto power lines; the live power lines fell onto a chain link fence, and when a 31-year-old man was walking their dog who touched the fence, the dog and person were both electrocuted. Nearby in the 1400 block of Disney Avenue, a large tree blew down onto a house causing a partial collapse of the second floor.

events.title: Lightning near Carney
events.description: 1 death. Baltimore County. A contracter was killed when they were struck by lightning while doing work in the 8800 block of Walther Boulevard.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Denton
events.description: 1 death. Caroline County. Photo of a camper significantly damaged by a fallen tree and the Martinak State Park Campground. This resulted in one injury to an occupant. Time estimated from radar. This was near the beginning of a macroburst which continued for about 18 miles east into Delaware with estimated peak winds of 110 mph.

events.title: Flash Flood near Autrey Park
events.description: 1 death. Montgomery County. Floodwaters rushed into the Rock Creek Woods Apartments shortly before 3 AM EST according to Montgomery County Police and Fire Officials. The water rose almost to the ceilings in some cases. A 19 year old male was deceased due to the floodwaters. ||Three people were hospitalized due to injuries that were not life threatening, and one firefighter suffered minor injuries.

events.title: Lightning near Ijamsville
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Frederick County. Lightning struck a house causing a fire in the 9500 block of Ball Road. The fire caused the structure to collapse, killing a firefighter who was inside.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Hollywood Park
events.description: 1 death. Montgomery County. A tree fell onto a car near the intersection of Delford Avenue and Two Farm Drive. The occupant was later pronounced dead.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Cedarhurst
events.description: 1 death. Carroll County. A couple of large trees were uprooted and a few 10-inch diameter trees were snapped off of Bloom Road. Numerous large trees were blown down in the vicinity of the intersection of Old Kays Mill Road and Deer Park Road, some onto houses. Half a dozen homes in the area had shingles blown off and a barn lost its roof on Black Steer Drive. One fatality occurred when a tree fell onto a man in the 2900 block of Bloom Road in Finksburg.

events.title: Tornado near Penn Mary Jct
events.description: 2 deaths. Baltimore City (c) County. A tornado touched down in Baltimore City at about 9:42 PM EDT on Friday evening, November 2, 2018. Initial damage was to a tractor trailer which was blown over on Interstate 95 just north of the Fort McHenry Tunnel. A few trees were topped just west of the interstate, and a fence line blew over on South Newkirk Street just to the east. This damage is consistent with winds of about 70 MPH.||The tornado tracked generally eastward roughly parallel to Holabird Avenue. events.title: Flash Flood near Calvary
events.description: 2 deaths. Harford County. A car was swept underneath a bridge along James Run road near the intersection of State Route 136 and James Run Road. The car was later found near the intersection of Calvary Road and Schucks Road. Two fatalities occurred; one in the car swept downstream, and another of a person who attempted to assist the disabled vehicle.

events.title: Flash Flood near Ellicott City
events.description: 1 death. Howard County. Catastrophic flash flooding occurred in Ellicott City as a result of torrential short-term rainfall of 6-10 inches. One person died during a lull in the flooding when he attempted to help another person evacuate and was swept away. Floodwaters on the lower portion of Main Street in the 8000 block reached the bottom of second floors of businesses. In all, dozens of water rescues were performed, most from buildings.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Timonium
events.description: 1 death. Baltimore County. A tree fell onto a vehicle near Pot Spring Road and Deer Fox Lane. The tree falling onto the vehicle resulted in one fatality and three injuries.

events.title: Flash Flood near Ellicott City
events.description: 2 deaths. Howard County. The survey revealed clear signs of flooding both from the Patapsco River and from flash flooding within Ellicott City. Signs of flooding, including damaged pavement, were observed as far up as the intersection of Rogers Avenue and Frederick Road, where Hudson Branch came out of its banks. From this location, eyewitnesses reported seeing water not only in the creek, but moving swiftly down Main Street beginning just after dark. events.title: Flash Flood near Parkwood
events.description: 2 deaths (indirect). Montgomery County. Two people were electrocuted in a stairwell going down into a basement that was flooded. Reports stated a portable sump pump was in the standing water in the basement.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Poolesville
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Montgomery County. Numerous trees were reported down around town. Poolesville was without power for an extended period of time.

events.title: Flood near Savage
events.description: 1 death. Howard County. A pickup truck was swept off Brock Bridge Road by flood waters. The truck moved 150 feet south and ended in the Patuxent River.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Alesia
events.description: 1 death. Carroll County. Tree branches fell at a Youth Campsite.
